scope: Scalar-only review of local population-kernel verification and measured cost. No atmosphere, radiation field, stellar data or full rate matrix is published.

local_matrix.description: One C23 conditional Fe II rate matrix with supplied radiation and species density; not a complete native atmosphere state.

cotangents: logarithmic sensitivity of the weakest populated level

derivatives.final_core_test_scope: Three pivot orders of an independently solved stiff three-state tree; a four-state star with independently known weak populations, density normalization and transpose; existing metal and hydrogen regressions.
derivatives.prototype_conditioning_scope: Before promotion, six pivot orders and four positive synthetic matrices with rates spanning 40 decades passed. Those separate prototype checks are not a full native atmospheric validation.

measured_cost.allocation_definition: Compiled kernel memory_analysis temporary allocation, not whole-process peak RSS or atmospheric runtime.

test_count_scope: 72 regression cases, plus repeat23 atom cases after final test formatting;72 unique cases, not95.

negative_findings.finding: A previous implicit normalized-balance derivative using positive factors but a signed forcing failed the stiff three-state case.
negative_findings.disposition: Rejected; the new algorithm linearizes the original positive elimination without that forcing.

negative_findings.finding: The first factor-JVP proposal retained full per-pivot coefficient products in reverse mode.
negative_findings.disposition: Numerically equal but rejected for memory; the accepted version rematerializes those coefficients.

negative_findings.scope: Initial diagnostic acceptance check after numerical receipt was saved; derivative parity itself passed.
negative_findings.criterion: maximum absolute difference of d(log population) <1e-7
negative_findings.follow_up: Existing nested step1e-5 yields2.154622258387917e-9 with unchanged derivative and criterion; the observed100x refinement is consistent with central finite-difference truncation.

limits: The primal is stable positive GTH elimination; this is a custom algorithmic JVP, not a newly validated raw signed stationary-balance solve.
Only first derivatives and the specified fixtures/directions are checked; no arbitrary ill-conditioned rate domain or higher-derivative guarantee.
The paired large-matrix benchmark uses one externally supplied local rate matrix. Radiation, ionization, wind and thermal feedback are not solved here.
Two same-hardware timings and local allocation sizes do not establish a whole-atmosphere compile or execution improvement.
The active historical full reverse compilation and all six full-use readiness judgments remain unresolved and unchanged.
No new archive, public URL, raw rates, boundary arrays or stellar samples are included.
